title: tc-stage-bars
description:
A funnel as a list: a pill per stage sized to its share of the first, the counts and shares beside it, a headline that
follows the pointer, stat tiles, an optional period switch and a table view.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

stages.description: The stages, top of the funnel first – used when there are no `ranges`

ranges.description: Periods, each with its own stages and change – adds a switch to the header

range.description: The chosen range's id; unset is the first

delta.description: Change in the first stage against the period before, in percent – a range's own `delta` wins

stage.description: The picked stage's index, or null for none – it stays emphasised while nothing else is pointed at

mono.description: Draws every pill in one ink instead of a colour per stage

showIcons.description: Draws the stages' icons at the pills' left ends; show-icons="false" hides them

still.description: Draws everything where it ends, with no entrance

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over `defaultStageBarsLabels`

color.description: The pill's colour: any CSS colour or token – by default the chart colour for the stage's place

icon.description: SVG path data for a 24×24 stroked icon, drawn at 14px at the pill's left end

label.description: The switch's word for it: "7 days"

delta.description: Change in the first stage against the period before, in percent
